title: School Calendar Early-Start Readiness
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=schoolcalendar:event
| search event_type=school_day early_start=true
| stats count as early_days avg(ready_buffer_min) as avg_ready_buffer_min by child_name
| sort avg_ready_buffer_min
value: Early-start readiness helps you see which mornings need more prep the night before.
implementation: Send early-start school mornings events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of early-start school mornings, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It flags what is happening with early-start school mornings, so odd changes stand out quickly.
